create_ClothoV2_dataset: create a ClothoV2 PyTorch Dataset instance with a transform for audio-caption pairs
setup_ClothoV2_dataset: setup the ClothoV2 dataset by downloading and extracting audio files and captions metadata
cache_file_download: cache a file from a URL by downloading it with curl to a local output path
collate_ClothoV2_batch: collate a batch of ClothoV2 samples into audios and captions tuples for DataLoader
getitem_ClothoV2_sample: get a ClothoV2 sample by index returning its audio path and five captions
